name: LeafDocket
tagline: Audit-ready compliance for independent dispensaries and grows
positioning: LeafDocket keeps small cannabis operators inspection-ready with state-specific tracking, METRC reconciliation, and one-click audit packets.

hero.h1: Stay inspection-ready without hiring a compliance team
hero.sub: LeafDocket turns messy spreadsheets and METRC exports into a live compliance record, so a surprise state inspection is a five-minute PDF, not a five-day scramble.

features.title: METRC reconciliation that catches drift
features.description: Nightly sync flags every mismatch between your POS, seed-to-sale tags, and physical counts before an inspector ever finds it.

features.title: One-click audit packets
features.description: Generate a state-formatted evidence bundle — manifests, waste logs, employee licenses — filtered to any date range in seconds.

features.title: State rule library
features.description: Requirements mapped to your license type and jurisdiction, with plain-English deadlines that update when the regs change.

features.title: Expiration alerts
features.description: Track badge renewals, lab COAs, and license dates so nothing lapses. Reminders land in email and Slack, not a forgotten calendar.

features.title: Waste and destruction logs
features.description: Log every gram of quarantined or destroyed product with timestamps and witnesses that hold up under review.

features.title: Role-based access
features.description: Give budtenders, managers, and your compliance lead exactly the view they need — every action stays logged and attributable.

testimonials.quote: Our last state audit took twenty minutes. I pulled the packet, the inspector checked three manifests, and we were done. Before LeafDocket that was a two-day panic with three of us digging through binders.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: The METRC reconciliation alone paid for itself. It caught a tag mismatch on a transfer that would have been a fine. I sleep better knowing it checks every night.
testimonials.name: Devon Pratt

testimonials.quote: I run two storefronts without a dedicated compliance hire. LeafDocket is basically that hire — it tells me what's due and hands me the paperwork ready to file.
testimonials.name: Anita Kohli

homepage.footerBlurb: LeafDocket helps independent cannabis operators stay compliant across every license, tag, and deadline — without a full-time compliance department.
